scope.commitEnumeration: All commit metadata reachable from the pinned default-branch HEAD within the window, including merges; not a count of distinct features.
scope.openItemSampling: Up to 300 updated-desc /pulls and mixed /issues records, plus top 100 comments-desc searches per type and latest 100 ordinary issues; merged by repository and number. Bodies, comments, patches and user identities omitted from retained indexes.
scope.searchQueries: repo:<repository> is:<pr|issue> is:open updated:<since>..<until>; created counts add created:<since>..<until>; merged counts use is:pr is:merged merged:<since>..<until>.
scope.consistency: Live GitHub queries are not atomic. State can change during collection even when activity dates are bounded. Counts of active ordinary issues were refreshed; other counts reflect their respective query.
scope.analysisDepth: Metadata triage across all retained indexes; selected PR/issue scopes and 18 patch/commit resources inspected selectively. This is not an exhaustive code review, reproduction of all issues or a security audit.
